comment: Dr. Bukky is a pretty nice guy. As others have mentioned, he encourages participation a lot. Sometimes it's not easy to understand what he's saying, but it all ties to the readings, and he provides the slides after class. There's a semester-long project, readings, a group project, and take-home block exams, which are open note....PARTCIPATE!

Dr. Bukky is a very easy teacher to have. All he asks from his students is to participate, which at times is a bit tedious as he is not great at asking questions people feel comfortable answering. But he is a very fair grader, his exams are easy and are take home, and the semester long project is actually kind of fun. He is a nice guy overall.

I took ANTH 379 with Dr Bukky. So kind, caring, and funny. One of the most informative classes I have taken at Richmond. The homework was very manageable. Papers and assessments were also reasonable. I would definitely take another course with this professor
Dr. Bukky is the best. He's so so sweet and he communicates very well if you have questions or concerns. I reached out to him a ton this semester and he was always so helpful. Great person
If you wanna learn something, do not take this professor. Everyone agrees that nobody can learn from his tedious lecture. All the lessons are ridiculous and everything is so conceptual.

It says ANT101 but I took FYS100. Dr. Bukky is very kind and understanding. Read 1-3 PDFs before class, write a question, comment, & quote from them, discuss openly in class, watch related videos & take notes on them in class (handed in). Also a group project and final project which are a good amount of writing & work but still quite fun. Recommend

I took his FYS100. Solid teacher, easily accessible after class. Aslong as you participate and do his weekly QCQ (question, comment, quote) you'll do fine. Also i'm not a good writer but he grades according to the rubric so do exactly what the rubric says.

Dr. Bukky is very nice. He appreciates participation in class and it helps your grade. Three tests are somewhat challenging but can be taken at home. One large project that goes on all semester. Easy class, his directions are confusing but if you ask questions they are usually simple in the end.
